nodes.title: Generation
nodes.summary: Introduces the generation portion of power systems, emphasizing its role in producing electrical energy.
objectives: Explain the role of generation within the overall power system

nodes.title: Generators
nodes.summary: Covers generators as the primary machines that convert mechanical energy into electrical energy.
objectives: Differentiate generators from other equipment in a power plant

nodes.title: Synchronous Machines
nodes.summary: Presents synchronous machines, a key class of rotating electrical machines used in generation.
objectives: Explain the operating principle of synchronous machines
Identify the main components of a synchronous machine

nodes.title: Excitation
nodes.summary: Explains excitation concepts and the two principal excitation system types—static and brushless—and their key components.
objectives: Define the purpose of excitation in a generator
Compare static and brushless excitation systems
Identify components such as rectifiers and rotating diode bridges

nodes.title: Prime Movers
nodes.summary: This section introduces prime movers and the major categories of turbines used as prime movers. It covers steam, gas, and hydro turbine types and their basic characteristics.
objectives: Identify the concept of prime movers
Distinguish between steam, gas, and hydro turbines
Explain basic applications of each turbine type

nodes.title: Distribution
nodes.summary: This section provides an overview of electrical distribution, defining its role in delivering power from generation to end users.
objectives: Describe the function of distribution within a power system

nodes.title: Switchgear
nodes.summary: This section introduces switchgear, describing its purpose in controlling, protecting, and isolating electrical equipment.
objectives: Explain the primary functions of switchgear in a power system

nodes.title: Circuit Breakers
nodes.summary: This section covers circuit breakers, focusing on their ratings and performance specifications, including voltage, current, and short‑circuit interrupting capability.
objectives: Identify circuit breakers as protective devices
Interpret breaker ratings such as rated voltage and current
Understand short‑circuit interrupting capacity of a breaker

Generation

Introduces the generation portion of power systems, emphasizing its role in producing electrical energy.

Objectives:
- Define power generation
- Explain the role of generation within the overall power system
properties.heading: Generation

properties.text:
Generators

Covers generators as the primary machines that convert mechanical energy into electrical energy.

Objectives:
- Describe the function of generators
- Differentiate generators from other equipment in a power plant
properties.heading: Generators

properties.text:
Synchronous Machines

Presents synchronous machines, a key class of rotating electrical machines used in generation.

Objectives:
- Explain the operating principle of synchronous machines
- Identify the main components of a synchronous machine
properties.heading: Synchronous Machines

properties.text:
Excitation

Explains excitation concepts and the two principal excitation system types—static and brushless—and their key components.

Objectives:
- Define the purpose of excitation in a generator
- Compare static and brushless excitation systems
- Identify components such as rectifiers and rotating diode bridges
properties.heading: Excitation

properties.text:
Prime Movers

This section introduces prime movers and the major categories of turbines used as prime movers. It covers steam, gas, and hydro turbine types and their basic characteristics.

Objectives:
- Identify the concept of prime movers
- Distinguish between steam, gas, and hydro turbines
- Explain basic applications of each turbine type
properties.heading: Prime Movers

properties.text:
Distribution

This section provides an overview of electrical distribution, defining its role in delivering power from generation to end users.

Objectives:
- Define electrical distribution
- Describe the function of distribution within a power system
properties.heading: Distribution

properties.text:
Switchgear

This section introduces switchgear, describing its purpose in controlling, protecting, and isolating electrical equipment.

Objectives:
- Define switchgear
- Explain the primary functions of switchgear in a power system
properties.heading: Switchgear

properties.text:
Circuit Breakers

This section covers circuit breakers, focusing on their ratings and performance specifications, including voltage, current, and short‑circuit interrupting capability.

Objectives:
- Identify circuit breakers as protective devices
- Interpret breaker ratings such as rated voltage and current
- Understand short‑circuit interrupting capacity of a breaker
